turns.customer: Ridge 2 vs Summit 3 for backpacking, which one should I get?
turns.reply: How the two compare for backpacking: — Ridge 2 Backpacking Tent ($249.00, now $199.20, 4.6 stars) - 2-person, 3-season, 1,900 g - 20D ripstop nylon, 3000mm waterproof - Freestanding, two doors and two vestibules - In stock — Summit 3 Trekking Tent ($329.00, now $263.20, 4.5 stars) - 3-person, 3-season, 2,600 g - 30D ripstop nylon, 3000mm waterproof - Roomy steep-walled design aimed at long trips - Low stock Which to pick: Go Ridge 2 if weight matters — at 1,900 g it's 700 g lighter and built for two, the classic backpacking choice. Go Summit 3 if you're two people who want extra headroom and gear space, or a third might occasionally join, at the cost of 700 g carried on every mile. For most backpackers prioritizing pack weight, the Ridge 2 is the better fit at $199.20 right now. Want me to check stock in a specific color or set up a quote?
